topics.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Scope of Article 31C and Private Property Acquisition
topics.paper_relevance: GS Paper II - Polity and Constitution
topics.summary: A 9-judge Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court heard arguments on whether private resources can be considered 'material resources of the community' under Article 39(b) for distribution to serve the common good.
key_takeaways: Focuses on the interplay between Fundamental Rights (Article 14, 19) and Directive Principles of State Policy (Article 39(b)).
Re-examines the precedent set in the Sanjeev Coke (1983) and Ranganatha Reddy (1977) cases regarding state control over private assets.

topics.title: RBI Releases Draft Framework for Climate Risk and Sustainable Finance
topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued guidelines mandating Regulated Entities (REs) to implement robust governance and risk management frameworks to address climate-related financial risks.
key_takeaways: Introduces requirements for climate scenario analysis and stress testing by banks.
Aims to foster sustainable lending aligned with India's Net-Zero emission targets for 2070.

topics.title: India Signs 10-Year Long-Term Contract to Operate Chabahar Port in Iran
topics.summary: India Ports Global Limited (IPGL) signed a long-term agreement with Iran's Ports and Maritime Organisation (PMO) for operations at the Shahid Beheshti Terminal in Chabahar Port.
key_takeaways: Enhances India's trade connectivity with Central Asia and Russia via the INSTC (International North-South Transport Corridor).
Bypasses land routes through Pakistan, boosting strategic presence in the Indian Ocean Region.

topics.title: MoEFCC Reports Expansion of Invasive Alien Species Threatening Western Ghats Biodiversity
topics.summary: A recent assessment highlights the rapid spread of invasive species like *Senna spectabilis* and *Lantana camara* in Western Ghats protected areas, displacing native flora.
key_takeaways: Aligns with Target 6 of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF).
Underscores the need for eco-restoration policies and biological control measures in sensitive ecosystems.

topics.title: ISRO Successfully Tests 3D-Printed Liquid Rocket Engine
topics.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully conducted a hot test of a 3D-printed liquid rocket engine (PS engines), reducing manufacturing time and material usage.
key_takeaways: Utilizes Additive Manufacturing technology, lowering raw material waste by nearly 60%.
Enhances efficiency for the PS4 stage of the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV).
